title: Implant consult for a missing lower molar, diabetic patient

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: We just got back from a cruise to Alaska.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Sounds amazing. So number thirty was extracted about a year ago.

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: My diabetes is better, my last A1c was six point eight. I take metformin.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Good. The bone looks adequate on the x-ray but I want a CBCT scan before we plan the implant for thirty.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: If the scan looks good we'll place the implant in thirty next month.
